items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: We played a battle of music at the Savoy Ballroom. We had 5,000 people in that ballroom with this particular band against Chick Webb.

ctx.x: In the city. In New York City.
In New York City -- the Savoy Ballroom. In fact, I had the honor of being right next on the bandstand to the late great Chick Webb.
